name: review-fix
description: Review a part of the code, then fix only what a refuter or a probe confirms; re-check each fix

steps.title: Review it
steps.prompt:
Review, without changing any file: {target}

Bugs, missing tests, risky code. Report each real problem in `findings`: its place (file:line), what is wrong, how it is known (`deterministic` with the command or hunk that shows it as `proof`, else `inferential`) and its `cause`: when the target names a change (a branch, a commit, a diff), whether that change caused it; when it names code as it stands, there is no change to blame or excuse, so `unknown`. Say plainly when there is none.

steps.title: Decide what the review only read
steps.prompt: Decide, without changing any file, the findings on: {target}

steps.title: Fix the confirmed findings
steps.prompt:
Fix the confirmed findings below, in: {target}

Run the tests before you stop.

steps.title: Check each fix
steps.prompt: Check, without changing any file, the fix just made in: {target}
